data.name: Dennis
data.long_meaning: The name Dennis is derived from the ancient Greek name Dionysios, which means 'follower of Dionysus'. In Greek mythology, Dionysus was the god of the vine, the grape harvest, winemaking, wine, ritual madness, religious ecstasy, and theatre. Dennis was adopted as a personal name in the English-speaking world.

in_greek.name: Δennis
in_greek.meaning: Δennis σημαίνει ισχυρός και αποτελεσματικός στο Θεό
